title: 第二章 重生
content_zh:
斯多克公爵府中灯火辉煌，早开始的圣宴奏起结尾的音乐，美妙的女声带着人类欲望满足时的振奋，用节节的高音告诉大家，公爵大人是伟人，公爵的英勇献身精神要被载入史册，编进圣曲，永远流传。

    这样的宴会一般要持续上好几日，而这次已经持续了十多天，不过这正是斯多克公爵最希望看到的。

    公爵府内院最深处那个房间里，正有两三人忙碌着，一个很大的玻璃棺内盛着满满的鲜血，血泊中浮着一个裸体女孩，十七八的样子，苍白的脸上没有一点表情，看起来不过是一具尸体。

    “还有多久？”一个中年人问道。

    “大概还要几天，手脚还没有完全恢复。”那个站在容器前进行观察的年青女子回答道。

    “嗯。”中年人点了点头，走回自己的位置前坐下，拿起桌上的文件开始仔细的阅读起来，这是新下来的职位认命，自己的位置没变，手下很多人的位置都有所调动，不过不算太大，应该不会有什么问题。

    “为什么……为什么？为什么？”突然，玻璃棺中的女孩猛的坐起，睁开了双眼瞪得圆圆的，有些吓人，而口中一直问的为什么，又显得有些迷茫。

    一切发现的这样突然，弄的站在棺前的年青女子连惊叫声都锁在喉口，一点反应都没有的愣在了那里，最远处的那个老头也呆了，毕竟这样的情况不在预料之内。

    “你醒了？”中年人倒是很快便清醒过来，走到棺前问道。

    “你是谁？”棺中的女孩瞪着那双赤色的眸子，如嗜血的怪物般盯着中年人，让他不敢再走近一步。

    “不认识我了？”对方笑了，很是满意的回头看了那个发呆的老头一眼，“你的预料很准，她真的失去了一切的记忆。”

    “什么意思？这里是哪里？你们是什么人？为什么我会在这里？”女孩轻轻一跃便从血色弥漫的玻璃棺中跳了出来，站在所有人的面前。

    “爱莎！带她去洗个澡，穿好衣服！”中年人扫了一眼面前的女孩，命令道，“然后我们再慢慢谈。”

    跟着那个叫爱莎的女子出了这个房间，如怪物般的女孩，用她那双刚刚睁开的血色眸子观察着四周的一切，只是除了陌生，还是陌生。

    “为什么我会在这里？”落后好几步的女孩一闪，已经站到了爱莎的身旁。

    “这个波伊队长会告诉你，请你稍等。”已经完全清醒过来的爱莎很是平静的拒绝了，然后带着她去了隔壁的房间洗澡穿衣，再次出现在中年人他们面前的女孩，已经是一个一身洁白衣裙的女孩，美丽可爱，身材纤细高挑，除了那双血色的眸子之外，怎么看，她都是一个正常的人类女孩。

    “我是谁？”女孩正视着中年人的双眼，毫不畏惧的迎上对方探究的目光。

    “看来你真的什么都不记得了，唉！没想到会伤的这么重。”说着，那个中年人上前一步，轻轻的拍了拍女孩的肩膀，“你叫zaya，代号Z，是吸血鬼猎人，你还知道吸血鬼是什么东西吧？”

    “当然知道，我不是白痴！”女孩瞪了对方一眼，“你是波伊队长？”

    “嗯，爱莎告诉你的？”中年人转头看了一眼那个女子。

    “她说波伊队长会告诉我一切。”女孩回答道。

    “不错，你想知道什么，我都会告诉你。”波伊说着，回到位置前坐下，指了下前面的空位，“你也坐下！”

    “我为什么会失忆？”女孩来到波伊的对面坐下。

    “因为受了太重的伤，你已经在那个玻璃棺内躺了近十天了。”波伊平静的回答道。

    “什么事让我受了那么重的伤？”

    “一群有组织的吸血鬼，魔王的爪牙，这次你的任务是消灭他们，不过结果似乎倒了过来，你被他们消灭了，所以我们费了很大的劲才将你复活，只是你失忆了。”

    听完对方的说明，女孩静静的坐着，十几分钟过去了，她一直保持着沉默，正当所有人都觉得她接受了波伊所说的一切时，她突然抬头，“凭什么让我相信这一切，既然我失忆了，那么你说什么都可以。”

    “这……”波伊一愣，当初公爵大人可没跟他说这个女孩如此聪明。
content_en:
Standing high in the air, with an interesting smile on his face, he turned to him beside him, "Your prey is really special!"

"Not special, but very principled and smart. He knows what is best for him." The man next to him had a straight face and no smile at all. Of course, this was just an external expression. No one knew whether he was smiling on the inside, not even him beside him.

"Smart?" He smiled. "Smartness may lead to extreme stupidity in the end."

"That's her choice. Now don't you decide to let her make her own choice?" His neither humble nor arrogant expression makes people look naturally uncomfortable. However, this is also an expression that has to be seen, because he cannot be lost to someone. No matter what kind of relationship is maintained, as long as he is still in heaven, then he is a member of heaven and has to do something for heaven.Things, and everything he has is what heaven has, this is the most important thing, so no matter how unhappy he is, he can still squeeze out a smile from his heart, and bright, "Since she has chosen you, it is your business. This should be a good thing for me. She is not an easy little girl to deal with. I hope you can deal with her and step into the gate of heaven as soon as possible."

"Yes." The other party responded softly. As for whether he really agreed or not, who can tell!

After the two talked, Enel and the others had already walked away.

"Then I'll go back to Jiyingbao first." Someone suggested.

"Well, I hope you will have a wonderful wedding." The other party congratulated reluctantly, but he just smiled meaningfully and took off to chase the two figures who were gradually disappearing in front of him.

It is not difficult to catch up with them at his speed, but what he has to do now is not to catch up with his peers, but to return to Jiyingbao one step ahead of them. First, he has not been back during this period of time, and the demon party also has a lot of things waiting for him to deal with. Second, he must prepare well for the upcoming wedding!At least you have to have a decently furnished new house, right?

Although he is a high-ranking angel, although he is a god who has experienced the changes in the world, although he should be able to see everything clearly, including birth, old age, illness and death, and the existence of love between men and women, but he is getting married, and wants to marry a girl who everyone wants but chooses him. He really can't control his heart and is excited and looking forward to it. Unknowingly, he has returned to Xuanling Valley, a place that gives him another identity.

At this time, the Xuanling Valley has been covered with a layer of haze after experiencing the patronage of the secret party or the sweepers of the Blood Kingdom. It seems that no one has set foot in it for a long time. The lack of popularity naturally means more gloom. The surrounding atmosphere carries a sub-zero temperature, hitting Plephis's face head-on., made him feel cold all over, but after shrugging, he frowned. After all, this was an extremely unlikely thing to happen, which made a being like him shiver. But this place is so special, and it is precisely because of this that he chose this place.Although Xu's past experience has been washed away for thousands of years, it is still clearly visible, so he decided to live here. What he looks forward to is that one day, he will step here again and he will not have the feeling of standing in awe. One day, he will be here again.When you step here for the first time, you are no longer an outsider breaking into someone else's house, but a master. Whether it is this castle, the tables and chairs in the castle, even the air, or the night wind, you must acknowledge him as the master and show due respect when you see him.

It's just a day like this that made him wait for more than five hundred years. To this day, he is still a guest. Every time he steps into the Xuanling Valley, he can feel the hostility and rejection of him by this valley.

Walking into the castle step by step, his calm eyes swept over everything in the castle. The obvious dust led him straight through the castle and all the way to the back mountain. There would always be some noise there. After he knew Sal's existence, what he had been thinking about was whether the secret of the back mountain should be moved elsewhere, so that he would not have to worry about Sal's leakage.

With this in mind, he walked to the residence of the members of the Back Mountain Demon Party, but there were only empty houses of various sizes, high and low, with no one inside. A place with many residents suddenly turned into an abandoned town, giving people an unacceptable feeling.

What made him even more stunned was that after passing through the denser forest behind the house, a lot of footprints suddenly appeared on the originally flat black ground, which were messy and intricate. So he accelerated and rushed into the strange black hole. As a result, the smell of blood that hit his nostrils disappeared, and was replaced by a strange smell, a smell that did not exist deep in his memory, with a dark and sacred breath, which powerfully covered up the damp and decaying atmosphere in the cave.Come, when he guessed, he had already arrived at the destination, and the result was just as he had just thought, what should have been there was gone, there were no traces around, and there were no footprints of the glass coffin being taken away. It looked like it had suddenly disappeared from this world. So, he turned and rushed towards the residence of the members of the Demon Party, but the disappearance there was so strange that it was incomprehensible. After all, without his order, who could have taken them away from the back mountain.

After observing for a while, he had a look of disbelief. However, no matter how unbelievable he was, the facts were in front of him. He had no choice but to return to the castle, and then think about what to do next. It was impossible for Heaven to arrange a wedding for him anymore, either by bringing back the people stationed in Grimu, or by bringing back those who disappeared in the back mountains. However, both of these things were not easy to do. There was another point that he didn't remember until he returned to the castle again, that is, why were the third parties not there?According to their habits, at least one person will stay here waiting to collect money?how?Could it be that habits are so easy to change?

If not, then what makes the Xuanling Valley, which outsiders dare not take a step closer, turn into an empty valley?Blood Country?

It is the most likely murderer. However, based on his understanding of the Blood Kingdom King Saint Grad, he should not suddenly send out enough sweepers to wipe out the Hanging Spirit Valley. Firstly, he does not seem to have that many sweepers. Secondly, by doing so, he will advance the war between the two parties of the Magic Secret Party. This does not seem to be of any benefit to him, especially at a time when many lords have turned to the Magic Party.

If you are smart enough, you must at least deal with these lords one by one, and then deal with the demon party after regaining the territory. In the eyes of Philopus, Saint Grad is definitely a smart man.

Do smart people do stupid things?
